random_variable: indicator I(delta(W)>epsilon or certificate unresolved) for a newly drawn trajectory W
delta: phase-sensitive full-operator synthesis error;0<=delta<=2 for ideal-unitary circuit targets
IID: explicit assumption on trajectory draws;not established merely by PCG64 or paired seed generation
sample_selection: fixed held-out n before outcomes;old exploratory cohort cannot be silently treated as fresh validation
all_occurrences: P(any uncertified/bad occurrence among M)<=M*q_upper;needs separately allocated beta and dependence-aware sampling model
size_requirement: n>=log(alpha)/log(1-beta/M) for zero failures if target q<=beta/M
expected_error: E delta<=epsilon+(2-epsilon)*q_upper under the same law;operator/mean-signal propagation and statistical confidence must remain separate
alternative_mean: Hoeffding for bounded delta can be used with validated sample upper bounds under IID;not evaluated here
